common_temporal: same attention LSTM and training settings as full model

funds.filter: induced graph on explicitly admitted address cohort only; independent assumption pending actual source
funds.status: blocked: exact 65-entity address mapping and historical vintage not recovered

graphwave.approximation: exact sparse matrix exponential actions, capacity failure before unbounded dense materialization
graphwave.heat: matrix exponential on bounded fixtures, sparse approximation must pass oracle
graphwave.readout: real and imaginary empirical characteristic function over heat wavelet column for each scale/time, mean over nodes

node2vec.embedding_alignment: training-only anchor basis; test only aligned to immediately preceding available snapshot
node2vec.loss: skipgram negative-sampling sum positive and five negative logsigmoid terms, mean over positive pairs
node2vec.transition: unweighted weak undirected; isolated walk stops
node2vec.window: fixed symmetric distance<=5; no dynamic window

watchyourstep.batching: exact blockwise pair objective, no negative subsampling
watchyourstep.initialization: normal std0.1 for embeddings; zeros for attention logits
watchyourstep.objective: Eq12 arXiv:1710.09599v2: beta*L2(q)^2 + sum(-E[D]*logsigmoid(LR^T) - indicator(A=0)*logsigmoid(-LR^T)); E[D]=10*I*sum softmax(q)_k*T^k

graph_alignment: node2vec/WatchYourStep: align successive embeddings with orthogonal Procrustes on common addresses only, no future graph; first orientation fixed by seed. No anchors => unavailable. Mean node pooling. GraphWave coordinates intrinsically fixed by frozen times/scales.

metrics.aggregation: annual metrics averaged equally across seven folds; seed mean/range separately; pooled date results also retained
metrics.zero_division: 0 for undefined precision/recall/F1; MAPE undefined if true price <=0

hlstm.implementation: independent temporal adaptation of Hou et al. 2020 Fig2/Eqs3-4
hlstm.readout: shared lower final state per chunk, upper final state to task head
hlstm.training: common frozen training.json, not Hou cyberattack training settings

svm.classification: SVC C=1 kernel=rbf gamma=scale class_weight=None probability=False tol=0.001 max_iter=-1; sigmoid(decision_function) is uncalibrated diagnostic score, threshold 0
svm.regression: SVR C=1 epsilon=0.1 kernel=rbf gamma=scale tol=0.001 max_iter=-1

uncertainty.missing_daily_runs: unavailable interval until pre-result gap-aware amendment

whales.filter: drop every edge incident to whale, rebuild derived features
whales.threshold: strictly greater than 0.9*max wallet volume within same week
whales.volume: per-week incoming+outgoing native value; self transfer counted twice
